built_with: React Native 0.87 (TypeScript), with Swift and Objective-C native modules and prebuilt Go and Rust libraries

engine.text: Embedded LND {version:lnd-zeus} (Go), Zeus's fork, run in the app process through the Lndmobile framework; its on-chain wallet is btcwallet. LDK Node (BDK on-chain wallet) is an option, and Zeus can also drive a remote node

chain_data.text: Neutrino (BIP157/158) through five default peers, two run by Olympus; the person can add peers or allow only their own. The LDK Node option uses an Esplora server (ZEUS by default, custom allowed)

third_party.text: Nobody for on-chain funds: they sit in the embedded LND wallet under one key on the phone. Channel partners matter only for Lightning funds

libraries.text: React Native, bitcoinjs-lib, noble and scure cryptography, bc-ur and BBQr for QR signing, Nostr (NDK), Tor (react-native-nitro-tor), Cashu CDK
libraries.cite: zeus:package.json:53; zeus:package.json:56; zeus:package.json:59; zeus:package.json:77; zeus:package.json:86; zeus:package.json:117; zeus:package.json:148

bitcoin_library_not_counted: btcwallet (with btcd and neutrino), Go modules under LND; bitcoinjs-lib for PSBTs and sweeps; BDK and rust-bitcoin in the optional LDK Node

prebuilt.text: Lndmobile.xcframework (LND), LDKNodeFFI.xcframework (LDK Node), and the Cashu CDK and restore xcframeworks, downloaded from release archives pinned by SHA-256

patched: Six postinstall scripts rewrite installed npm packages (two are Android-only: jcenter and notifications; four reach iOS: NativeEventEmitter, keychain cloudSync, noble-hashes exports, reanimated C++); rn-nodeify shims crypto, stream and dgram
